name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for waiver of the immunity of Petr Bystron
part_text:
The European Parliament is lifting the legal protection that Petr Bystron, a German member, has as an elected representative. German prosecutors want to charge him over a photo montage he posted on Twitter in 2022, which they say showed a banned symbol. The Parliament agreed to let the case go ahead. The alleged act happened before he was elected to the European Parliament, and the Parliament found no sign that the case is meant to harm his political work.

- German prosecutors can now pursue criminal charges against Petr Bystron over the 2022 tweet.
- It affects Petr Bystron, a member of the European Parliament from Germany.
- The case returns to the Munich authorities; the Parliament's decision goes to them and to him.
